hook: Google's Gemini 4 Argon matched GPT-6.1 Sol with a 76% pass rate.

sections.voiceover: Google's Gemini 4 Argon matched GPT-6.1 Sol with a 76% pass rate.
sections.visual_cue: Side-by-side bar chart showing Gemini 4 Argon and GPT-6.1 Sol tied at 76% benchmark score.
b_roll: AI benchmark dashboard showing model accuracy scores

sections.voiceover: Google released Gemini 4 Argon on October 13, 2026, before November 8 LLMBenchmark Index results. Where does computer control rank against GPT-6.1 Sol's 71.4%?
sections.visual_cue: Calendar graphic marking October 13, 2026, morphing into a counter showing 150 test conversations and 71.4% comparison metric.
b_roll: Automated website agent interface processing incoming customer prompts

sections.voiceover: However, Gemini 4 Argon didn't win OS World tests, scoring 69% in computer environments.
sections.visual_cue: OS environment benchmark graphic highlighting the 69% score for desktop control performance.
b_roll: Screen recording of automated computer interface navigation test

sections.voiceover: The index ranked Gemini 4 Argon #4 out of 114 models. Both systems charge identical rates at $4.00 per 1M tokens. The evaluation scored Argon at 66 points versus Sol's 67.2 points.
sections.visual_cue: Leaderboard graphics showing rank #4 among 114 models, followed by a price tag icon at $4.00 per 1M tokens.
b_roll: LLM index ranking chart scrolling through tested models

sections.voiceover: That matches GPT-6.1 Sol at $4.00 per 1M tokens.
sections.visual_cue: Final comparison summary graphic lockup showing $4.00 per 1M tokens rate for both models.
b_roll: Split screen overview of model performance specs
